facts.fact: The CBK page states that the National Payment System Act 2011 provides the legal framework for payment systems and providers and that the National Payment System Regulations 2014 operationalise it; the page is dated only 2026 (published date used).
facts.system: National Payment System Act 2011 and Regulations 2014

facts.fact: The CBK page states that mobile phone money transfer operators are authorised as Payment Service Providers under the National Payment System Act 2011 and Regulations 2014, in categories including e-money issuer and small money issuer; the page is dated only 2026 (published date used).
facts.system: National Payment System Act 2011 and Regulations 2014
